verdict.rationale: E2B is sandbox infrastructure for running AI-generated code. The only data-analysis evidence describes a developer building block: you bring your own LLM, and E2B executes the code it generates. There is no evidence that E2B itself generates insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product, so that pattern earns no credit and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
